name: commerce-agents/handoff
description: Verifies a one-time Claude Commerce handoff code, adopts the UCP cart context token into the storefront session and redirects the shopper to checkout.

description.en-GB: POST /claude-commerce/continue verifies a one-time handoff code (ADR-10) and continues the agent cart in the Shopware checkout.
description.de-DE: POST /claude-commerce/continue prüft einen einmaligen Handoff-Code (ADR-10) und führt den Agenten-Warenkorb im Shopware-Checkout fort.
